meta.title: About
meta.description: Meet the team and values behind DGN Yapı's prestigious living projects in İzmir.

about.title: Designing the future with confidence, building it with modern architecture.
about.lead: Since the day we were founded, DGN Doğan Yapı has combined traditional reliability with modern technology to build aesthetic, durable and sustainable living spaces.

story.title: More than buildings — safe living spaces.
story.p1: Since the day we were founded, DGN Doğan Yapı has set itself the task of building not just structures, but safe living spaces. By combining aesthetics with functionality and traditional reliability with modern technology, we add value to the city's architectural fabric.
story.p2: Our top priorities on every project are durability, on-time delivery, and user-focused design. We take pride in blending our technical experience with architectural aesthetics to produce livable and sustainable spaces.

values.title: We honor what we promise — and stand behind what we build.

trust.title: Trust
trust.body: A contract is a starting point, not a finish line. We deliver on time, to the standard we promised.

quality.title: Quality
quality.body: Branded, certified materials. An in-house team of architects and engineers. We never compromise on engineering.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Open communication at every stage. From the construction site to the delivery date, we keep you in the loop.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: We design for tomorrow's lifestyle, not today's checklist. Our buildings are made to last.

process.title: How a DGN Yapı project comes to life.

steps.title: 01 — Land & Concept
steps.body: We analyze the character, needs, and potential of every location. The right project on the right plot.

steps.title: 02 — Architecture & Engineering
steps.body: Our in-house team of architects and engineers produces designs that prioritize seismic safety and quality of life.

steps.title: 03 — Construction
steps.body: Branded materials, certified subcontractors, and a transparent site under regular inspection at every stage.

steps.title: 04 — Delivery & Beyond
steps.body: After handover we stay with you through technical support and warranty — the relationship doesn't end at the door.

kvkk.title: Privacy Notice
kvkk.subtitle: Disclosure under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law
kvkk.intro: DGN Yapı ("the Company"), as data controller under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK"), provides this notice to inform you about how we process the personal data you submit through our contact form.

sections.heading: Data Controller
sections.body:
DGN Yapı
Esenlik Mh. 9035 Sk. No: 2/A, Karabağlar / İzmir
doganoz47@hotmail.com

sections.heading: Personal Data Processed
sections.body: The following data submitted through our contact form is processed:
items: The content of the message you submit

sections.heading: Purposes of Processing
sections.body: Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:
items: Responding to your questions, requests, and suggestions
Enabling our sales office to follow up with you

sections.heading: Legal Basis
sections.body: Your personal data is processed pursuant to KVKK Article 5/2(c), as it is directly related to the establishment or performance of a contract, and Article 5/2(f), as it is necessary for our legitimate interests, provided that such interests do not infringe on your fundamental rights and freedoms.

sections.heading: Transfers
sections.body: Your personal data is shared on a limited basis with our email infrastructure provider (Resend Inc.) and our hosting provider (Vercel Inc.). It is not shared with any other third parties.

sections.heading: Retention Period
sections.body: Your personal data is retained for the period required to respond to your request. If retention is required for longer due to legal obligations, the periods set forth in the relevant legislation will be observed.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: Under KVKK Article 11, you may apply to the Company to exercise the following rights regarding your personal data:
items: Learn whether your personal data is being processed
Request information about it if processed
Learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used in accordance with that purpose
Learn the third parties to whom your data has been transferred, in Turkey or abroad
Request correction if your data has been processed incompletely or inaccurately
Request deletion or destruction within the conditions set out in the KVKK
Request that corrections, deletions, and destructions be communicated to third parties to whom the data was transferred
Object to a result that disadvantages you arising solely from automated processing
Claim damages if you have suffered loss due to unlawful processing

sections.heading: How to Apply
sections.body: To exercise your rights under KVKK, you may contact us at doganoz47@hotmail.com or by sending a written application to the postal address above. Your application will be answered within thirty (30) days at the latest, in accordance with KVKK Article 13.
